commitResults.messageTitle: Add readable content in scrollable Help window
commitResults.messageBody:
Modified HelpWindow.fxml and HelpWindow.java to provide a scrolling
TextArea, referencing UserGuide.md. This presents a forgetful user with
the instructions in UserGuide.md, even without an internet connection.
Changes in UserGuide.md will also change the help instructions for
offline use. The URL functionality is preserved. The starting reference
for the help feature is ##Quick Start.

The current design includes a StripMarkdown method to remove markdown
syntax, but it may not be complete.

Also, the scrolling window is not auto-sized and the text turns out to
be white. This will change in the next iteration.

commitResults.messageBody:
Added a comparison window rendered with auto-scaling (though the window is still limited in width), which takes the command pattern:

"compare <n> <m>"

to place the n-th and m-th indexed person in the listpane side by side in the right hand pane.

Still requires: tests to verify CompareCommandParser's function and CommandParser's function.

Additional refinement: the ability to actually compare tags (e.g. reordering them, highlighting differences),
and more generally for the UI to allow for a larger right hand pane window.
